import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Pairwise scatter plot - Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Pairwise scatter plot - Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=60)
ax2.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Box plot for Petal Length
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df.boxplot(column='petal_length', by='species', ax=ax3, patch_artist=True)
ax3.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.sca(ax3)
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
ax3.get_figure().suptitle('')

# 4. Violin plot for all measurements
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
data_melted = df.melt(id_vars='species', var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value (cm)')
sns.violinplot(data=data_melted, x='Measurement', y='Value (cm)', hue='species', 
               ax=ax4, split=False, inner='quartile')
ax4.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Distribution of All Measurements by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Species', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.setp(ax4.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
